provenance.what: Manual RNO2A OpenCode boundary stress with compaction disabled, proving served context overflow, invalid UTF-8 tool output, output truncation, agent timeout, and verifier timeout remain typed and bounded inside a concurrent RL rollout workflow.
why_these_thresholds: The daily OpenCode lane owns the optimizer/checkpoint assertion. This mixed negative-path suite intentionally masks errors that cannot carry behavior logprobs.
The large-output case must become one typed context-length failure rather than retrying forever or crashing the rollout worker.
Malformed bytes must still produce a verified exact-TITO trajectory, and output, agent, and verifier limits must remain independently visible.
provenance.tightening: Keep the context-overflow case exact after production vetting; other event counts may vary with model tool-use behavior.
